Kode bermasalah:
```python
def paginate(items, page, per_page):
    start = page * per_page
    return items[start:start + per_page]
```

assert paginate(data, 3, 2) == [5]
assert paginate(data, 4, 2) == []
assert paginate(data, 0, 2) == []
assert paginate(data, 1, 0) == []
